description: Defines the SoapError class used for handling SOAP error information within the SuiteCRM project, including error setting and retrieval methods.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: A class representing SOAP error details, including error name, number, and description, with methods to set and retrieve error information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SoapError object with a default 'no_error' state.

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Sets the error details based on an error name, using external error definitions.

methods.name: get_soap_array
methods.description: Returns the error details as an associative array suitable for SOAP responses.

methods.name: getFaultCode
methods.description: Returns the error number as the fault code.
